meta.name: golden-chat-single
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat_single golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证黄金构建的聊天功能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden chat build

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可读取 golden_chat_single 的 Slack 聊天记录(共 1 条消息,来自 #general),基于其中的讨论内容回答关于方案、决策等问题。
howto.when: 在测试 golden_chat_single golden build 时,或需要查阅该聊天历史中的解决方案、团队决策时触发。

say.text: 请总结 golden_chat_single 聊天记录的内容。
say.note: Claude 会读取记录并给出摘要。

say.text: 这个聊天里讨论过哪些解决方案?
say.note: Claude 会从聊天历史中查找相关讨论。

say.text: 测试 golden_chat_single 时,历史记录有什么参考信息?
say.note: Claude 会结合聊天记录辅助测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read the Slack chat history for golden_chat_single (1 message in #general) and answer questions based on its content, such as solutions or decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when testing the golden_chat_single golden build, or when you need to look up solutions or team decisions from this chat history.

say_en.text: Summarize the content of the golden_chat_single chat history.
say_en.note: Claude will read the record and provide a summary.

say_en.text: What solutions were discussed in this chat?
say_en.note: Claude will search the chat history for relevant discussions.

say_en.text: When testing golden_chat_single, what reference info is in the history?
say_en.note: Claude will assist testing with the chat record.
